worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.summary: Cuts a cute act first to open a brief off-guard window, then lunges in with a heavy blow; if the follow-up lands while the window holds, it seizes the moment for more power and a better flinch. The window is short, so chasing from too far lets it expire.
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.use.0: Bait up close, then follow with a heavy hit
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.use.1: Fluster a foe and steal the initiative
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.use.2: Punish a foe that already dropped its guard
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.description: The lunge deals about %1$s damage; if the target is still inside the off-guard window, this hit's damage is multiplied by %2$s.

On a hit there is a %1$s chance to flinch the target for %2$s s, interrupting an interruptible action; while flinched it cannot start new moves or land ordinary attacks. A seize hit multiplies that chance by %3$s.

The cute act marks the target with a %1$s s off-guard window; the strike follows %2$s s later, and if it lands while the window holds it seizes the moment: the mark is consumed, the hit gains the seize power multiplier and the higher flinch chance shown above. Once the window expires, only a plain hit lands.
Lunges from the act toward the target up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block contact radius; a blocked path or a target you cannot catch means the lunge misses.
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.guile.on: Guile on: a longer act, a longer window and higher seize power/startle multipliers, but about 14%% less base power and a slower wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.guile.off: Guile off: about 16%% more base power and a faster wind-up, but a shorter off-guard window and smaller seize payoff.
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.timing: Cast at a foe within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.growth.0: At level %1$s the base hit rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.heartstamp.growth.1: At level %1$s the base hit rises to %2$s, the lunge to %3$s blocks, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
On: a longer act, a longer off-guard window and higher seize payoffs, but about 14%% less base power and a slower wind-up and cooldown, for baiting first. Off: a straight swing with about 16%% more base power and a faster wind-up but a smaller seize payoff.
The companion only starts the act on a threat this close; higher chases a little farther, lower waits until it is right next to the target.
On: a foe not yet flinched is preferred, since the flinch roll is worth more on a clean target; off makes all targets equal and follows the normal melee order.
